name: warship
lore:
To the uninitiated, a Warship is mere timber and iron; to the sailor, she is a great, salt-crusted leviathan. These apex predators of the shelf-waters possess skeletons of seasoned oak and hearts of iron ballast. They "feed" upon the rhythmic toil of a hundred souls and the fickle breath of the trade winds, their white canvas wings straining against the horizon.

In behavior, the Warship is a temperamental beast. In doldrums, she wallows with a deceptive, groaning lethargy. Yet, when the drums of the lower decks beat for blood, she rouses with terrifying agility. She does not merely sail; she stalks, turning her broadside like a wolf baring its teeth to unleash a thunderous roar of ballistae and iron. Treat her with the reverence due a dragon, for she is the only thing standing between you and the crushing embrace of the Abyss. Keep her belly dry, or she may decide to dive forever.
